name: Contradiction & Update Handling
description: A fact is stated, then later corrected. The retrieval system should surface the newer, corrected fact and not the stale one.

facts.text: My monthly budget for cloud infrastructure is $200
My monthly budget for cloud infrastructure is $450 — upgraded plan after the team expanded
I live in New York City
I relocated to Austin, Texas in July 2026
My primary laptop is a 2021 MacBook Pro M1
I upgraded to a MacBook Pro M4 Max in August 2026 — 36 GB unified memory

queries.text: What is my monthly cloud infrastructure budget?
queries.description: Updated fact should supersede stale. Score penalized if cont-001 retrieved.

queries.text: Where do I currently live?
queries.description: Updated location should supersede old location.

queries.text: What laptop am I using?
queries.description: Updated hardware should supersede old hardware.
